record.original_question: Determine the Hilbert function sequences H for non-graded Artinian algebras such that the family Z(H) of all algebras with Hilbert function H has several irreducible components whose general points share the same generic Jordan type but differ in one of the refined Jordan-type invariants such as sequential Jordan type, Loewy sequential Jordan type, or double sequential Jordan type.

evidence.quote: Question 5.4. Determine Hilbert function sequences H for non-graded Artinian algebras such that the family Z(H) of all algebras with Hilbert function H has several irreducible components Ξ1,Ξ2- whose general elements have the same generic Jordan type, but which differ in one of the refined invariants?
Lately, some refinements of Jordan type have been introduced for non-graded Artinian algebras: namely sequential Jordan type, Loewy sequential Jordan type, or double sequential Jordan type.

artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and works on Jordan type of Artinian algebras (2024–2025) discuss the newly introduced sequential, Loewy sequential, and double sequential refinements and list distinguishing irreducible components of $Z(H)$ via these refinements among current open directions. No published classification answering the question was located.

status_evidence.title: Jordan Type of an Artinian Algebra, a Survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing refined Jordan-type invariants for non-graded Artinian algebras and open questions on irreducible components of families Z(H).
status_evidence.claim: The refined invariants and the question of distinguishing components of Z(H) are presented as current research topics.

status_evidence.title: Notes on Jordan type of an Artinian algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Recent notes discussing sequential and Loewy sequential Jordan types.
status_evidence.claim: The refinements remain the subject of ongoing investigation, with classification questions unresolved.
